title: VoxelCore resources.json
description: Resource requests (<pack>/resources.json): lists of names per resource type. Names get the pack prefix (cinematic in pack base becomes base:cinematic). Unknown types are ignored with a warning.
markdownDescription: Resource requests (`<pack>/resources.json`): lists of names per resource type. Names get the pack prefix (`cinematic` in pack `base` becomes `base:cinematic`). Unknown types are ignored with a warning.

camera.markdownDescription: Cameras (`camera` resource type), e.g. `first-person`, `cinematic`. Used with the `cameras` library.
camera.description: Cameras (camera resource type), e.g. first-person, cinematic. Used with the cameras library.

post-effect-slot.markdownDescription: Post-processing effect slots (`post-effect-slot`, called *post-effect* in resources.md). Used with `gfx.posteffects`.
post-effect-slot.description: Post-processing effect slots (post-effect-slot, called post-effect in resources.md). Used with gfx.posteffects.
